# A message sent while the reply to a voucher is sealing: the Introduction still takes the index
# the reply names as where the newcomer starts reading, and the message follows it.

create alice g
join bob g
run
delay-next alice Seal
invite alice g bob
run
send alice g hello
jobs alice g
----
message to next box, 82 bytes

release alice
jobs alice g
----
message to box 0, 259 bytes
message to next box, 82 bytes

run
show bob g
----
— minting a voucher
— give the voucher code to a member of the group (it is also in voucher-g.txt)
— joined the group
alice: hello

send bob g read you
run
acked alice g
----
bob:1

refused
----
none
